title: An auth-absent operator failure sets auth_expired (fail-closed, not silent retry)
notes: GREEN: the worker emits an auth-absent line and fails; operatord's failure flow-control classifies it and sets the operator runtime_state to 'auth_expired' (operatord.py:984-999; matches test_operatord_daemon.py::test_failed_auth_task_sets_auth_expired). RED: fault makes the worker succeed -> status 'completed', operator stays idle -> the auth_expired assertion fails.
